metadata.title: Secure Storage OT Overlay SSPP
metadata.remarks: Applies operational technology (OT) constraints to secure storage systems supporting industrial control, facilities systems, and safety-critical operations.

import-profile.remarks: This overlay applies additional constraints for OT environments and SHALL further restrict operational flexibility.

pattern-bindings.remarks: Applies OT-specific trust, safety, and lifecycle constraints to secure storage.

system-characteristics.system-description: Storage environments supporting operational technology and control systems.

props.name: storage-environment
props.remarks: Identifies this storage as supporting operational technology workloads.

props.name: availability-priority
props.remarks: Storage behavior must be predictable and failure modes must be controlled.

props.name: immutability-requirement
props.remarks: Configuration, telemetry, and event data SHALL be immutable.

props.name: deletion-policy
props.remarks: Data deletion requires explicit governance approval due to safety and forensic considerations.

props.name: change-tolerance
props.remarks: Operational change to storage SHALL be minimized and tightly controlled.

system-implementation.remarks: OT storage SHALL prioritize safety, determinism, and evidence preservation over flexibility or performance.

prohibited-operational-actions.statement: Automation SHALL NOT perform deletion or lifecycle modification in OT storage environments.

escalation-requirements.statement: Any OT storage deviation SHALL escalate immediately due to potential safety impact.

back-matter.remarks: This overlay applies to all OT-related storage systems and SHALL override IT convenience assumptions.
